notes: Cities now sit at their real positions and show their real street networks, city footprints and named arterials from OpenStreetMap

The Tigris, Euphrates, Diyala, the Zab rivers, the Shatt al-Arab and others follow their true courses; lakes and reservoirs (Tharthar, Razazah, Habbaniyah, Qadisiyah, Mosul Dam, Dukan, Hamrin and more) and the Mesopotamian marshes take their real shapes
MSRs and highways follow the real roads between cities where OpenStreetMap has them
